title: Identify top and low-performing products by price
sqlValidation:
WITH RankedProducts AS (
    SELECT
        id, name, productType, brand, unitPrice,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY unitPrice DESC) AS highRank,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY unitPrice ASC) AS lowRank
    FROM dbo.Products
)
SELECT *
FROM RankedProducts
WHERE highRank <= 3 OR lowRank <= 3
ORDER BY unitPrice DESC;
sqlExpectedResult: The report returns the highest- and lowest-priced products based on the available product data.
